result:
I searched the CRM. Reply Deutschland, valantic AG and Körber Digital all complained in September 2025 after a change of contact.

The post-mortem from 2025-12-03 says: „Der Kunde hat das im Oktober klar angesprochen; wir haben zu spät reagiert."

I disagree with the decision to rotate managers so often. It costs more than it saves, and the record here shows why.

Prepare for a complaint within the first week.
